verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs explicitly list WebAuthn with security keys and device biometrics, passkeys, and passwordless (email/SMS OTP, magic links) as first-class sign-in options, confirming this story's core capability across multiple pages (auth0-docs-38, 82, 88, 34, 51). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration specifically of passkey/passwordless setup experience, and no detail on magic link configuration specifics beyond passing mention.
